code:
rates = customers.pivot_table(
    index="region", columns="channel",
    values="churned", aggfunc="mean")
sns.heatmap(rates, annot=True,
    fmt=".2f", cmap="Blues", ax=ax[0])
sns.scatterplot(data=customers,
    x="tenure_months", y="orders",
    hue="churned", alpha=0.6, ax=ax[1])
caption: Two panels, created on a 1x2 subplot grid.
